"Now that I have claimed the title of 
'Queen of the Oaks'! I'll be taking the 
Shuka Sho as well! After all, I am the 
star of the Tiara route!"

Some may weep in its shadow, but nothing 
can stop the path toward becoming a 
radiant princess! Ohohoho! Ohohoho!!

Behold, I shall shine ever so brightly in 
the live concert as well! Feast your eyes 
upon my Princess☆Upper!
